name: breathe
description: A breathing animation while Claude works: an aurora orb that expands and contracts in box breathing time, above the prompt in the terminal and in Claude Desktop. When the turn ends it finishes the breath you are in.

phaseSeconds.title: Seconds per phase
phaseSeconds.description: Length of each of the four box breathing phases: breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold. 4 is the classic box breathing.

startAfterSeconds.title: Show after (seconds)
startAfterSeconds.description: Wait this long into a turn before the animation appears, so a quick answer does not start a whole breath. 0 shows it right away.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the labels next to the animation.
